errors.evidence: The description of the green line's descent is incorrect. It drops to a value around 7 at epoch 2 (not 1), and at epoch 3 its value is approximately 5, not 0.1.
The red line (validation loss) does not have a data point at epoch 0; it starts at epoch 1 with a value of 40, not at epoch 0 with a value of 45.
At epoch 3, the red line's value is closer to 6, not 7. It is only slightly higher than the green line's value of ~5.
